The '''Raydonian settlement''' was located in the thick forests of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
At some point people settled on Raydonia and were supplied by Turtle Tankers who often ran supply runs.

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and his brother [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] arrived at the village aboard the [[Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]] to get the attention of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] by [[Massacre on Raydonia/Legends|slaughtering]] the population of the hamlet. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] later came to the destroyed village after receiving a holographic message from Maul who told him him to come the village alone. Maul warned Kenobi that if he did not arrive, he would kill all of the hostages and burn the planet. Kenobi later confronted both Maul and Opress with the help of former [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].
